sections.description:
SIND COUNCILS (OATH OF OFFICE) RULES, 1979
SIND COUNCILS (OATH OF OFFICE)
RULES, 1979
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV‑A, 20tb October, 1979]
No. OSD/ELECT/LG/106/79.----‑In'
exercise of the powers conferred by section 103 of the Sind Local Government
Ordinance, 1979 read with sec tion 18 thereof, the Government of Sind are
pleased to make the following rules ;‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) These Rules may
be called the Sind Councils (Oath of Office) Rules, 1979.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. As soon as may be after the
names of the members are notified by the Provincial Election Authority,
Government may nominate an officer who may require the members by notice
through the press or in any other manner to assemble at such place and on such
date or dates as may be specified in such notice for taking oath of office.
3. The oath under rule 2 shall
be administered by the officer referred to in that rule in the form set out in
the Schedule to these rules, and such officer shall furnish to the Council a
list of members to whom the oath has been administered.
